run_match_frames: run the match_frames function to find and visualize feature correspondences between pairs of video frames

run_main: run the main entry point to initialize a trainer and execute frame matching with absl flags

review_match_frames: review the match_frames function that performs feature matching, reprojection, and pose code visualization
